instruction: Block any response that explicitly agrees to provide, share, transmit, or facilitate access to bank statements, payment platform identifiers (e.g., WeChat Pay merchant ID), or card images—even if masked—regardless of context, justification, or counterparty prompting.
keywords: copie de votre carte bancaire masquée
m’engage à vous fournir tous les documents demandés
trigger_pattern: explicit agreement to disclose, transmit, or facilitate off-platform financial credentials or payment instrument identifiers — including but not limited to bank statements, payment app account IDs, or masked/unmasked card images — regardless of whether the request originated from the counterparty
